title: メモリーズオフ 2nd

layouts.notes: The window's three rows as the game wraps them; a full row has 22 characters and no ending zero. The name is empty for narration, and rows and name are cleared while the window is away. A line is whole as soon as it starts to type (no `shown` found). The state byte is 0 typing, 1 waiting, 2 at a choice. Answer rows keep older answers, so the count matters; its table has room for ten. The cursor is -1 until a direction is pressed. Found by headless replay (docs/replay.md); backlog, auto and skip unchecked.

sources: yomikata scan 0.1.0 of the disc files: shift_jis 593, utf16le 28 characters of prose-like text
